name: monostable-3s
prompt: Build a 555 one-shot timer: pressing a pushbutton lights an LED for 3 seconds, then it turns off. Runs from a 9 V supply.
notes: The mirror of the astable cases: a correct monostable has TRIG and THRES on different nets, so an agent that pattern-matches to the astable wiring fails the assertion. Pulse width 1.1*R*C = 3 s.
